text: OK one other thing can u make it possible for me to clearly see the unreachable and intersecting. the number means nothing if i dont know where it is at, so like target them all or something from a button action
resolution: Made the geometry counts locatable. mesh_audit.zig now takes an optional per-face Marks out-param and records which triangles it counted in the SAME pass that counts them, so a selection can never disagree with the number the panel is showing; over-budget audits clear the marks instead of leaving stale ones from a previous mesh. New host door __mesh_select_audit(kind) re-runs the marked audit (glass still transparent to reachability, matching the counting path), switches to face mode and selects intersecting / unreachable / both. In the UI each SHAPE fact row grew a target verb — shown only when the audit is real and found something — and the section head grew a select-both verb; press it, then F frames the selection. The Agent Seat got select-audit for the same reach. Two new tests cover marks-match-counts and no-stale-marks: tools/zig/zig build test-mesh-audit is 11/11 green, and rjit ship editor compiles clean.
